neighbours.label: the line end after a reader's personal question or request for help ('What action should we take?\n', 'Thanks for your help.\n'), as opposed to dialogue or a quiz
fire:
My dog keeps scratching his ear. What should we do?
Your dog may have mites.

I can't get this macro to run. Can anyone help?
Try the debug tool.

Our daughter refuses to eat vegetables. Any advice?
Start with small portions.

My tomato leaves are turning yellow. What can I do?
Check the watering.

I can't work out this formula.
Thanks in advance for any help.
Tom

My husband snores all night. Is that dangerous?
It can be a sign of apnea.

Our landlord won't return the deposit. What are our rights?
You may sue.

How do I remove red wine from a carpet?
Thanks for reading.
Ann
quiet:
"Does your dog still scratch his ear?"
The boy shook his head.

"Can anyone help me with this box?"
Jack ran over.

"Do you want more vegetables, dear?"
She said no.

What color are tomato leaves?
Green is the answer.

The formula worked.
We went home after that.
It rained.

"Does he snore all night?"
I laughed at that.

What is the capital of Peru?
Lima is the capital.

The carpet was red.
The wine was white.
It was late.
